decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (McD/2743/EP1, McD/2743/E3, McD/2743/E4, McD/2743/E5, McD/2743/P1, McD/2743/P2, McD/2743/P3, McD/2743/P4, McD/2743/P5 received 18/05/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Extension of time limit for planning application 00798/10-10A/P2 dated 15/04/2008 for the erection of a single storey rear extension to shop incorporating creation of new access to first floor self contained flat.
